test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(22, 7, 385)

(36, 9, 810)
solution:
The pattern followed in the given pairs is:

** (First term ÷ 2) × (Second term × 5 )= Third term**

(22, 7, 385)

(22 ÷ 2) × (7 × 5 ) = 11 × 35 = 385

(36, 9, 810)

(36 ÷ 2) × (9 × 5 ) = 18 × 45 = 810

Now we apply the pattern on the given options:

Option 1) (14, 3, 115)

 (14 ÷ 2) × (3 × 5 ) = 115 

 105 ≠ 115 

Option 2) (19, 4, 290)

 (19 ÷ 2) × (4 × 5 )= 290 
 190 ≠ 290 

Option 3) (26, 8, 420)

 (26 ÷ 2) × (8 × 5 ) = 420 
 520 ≠ 420 

Option 4) (27, 6, 405)

 (27 ÷ 2) × (6 × 5 ) = 405 
 405 = 405 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
